dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Bubu Pharmacy can be said to be the best infirmary in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu's skills are impeccable, his pharmacy is packed with rare herbs, and the young girl in charge of getting the herbs is extremely nimble.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: If I could attain just a tenth of their skill, I would have no regrets in this life.
